capabilities: Create and edit trade entries inline in a table view
Track PnL stats like win rate, profit factor, and best/worst trade
Configure pre-trade, entry, and exit checklist templates
Manage trading setup categories (accounts, symbols, sessions, order types)
Record backtest entries in a separate folder
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README says the plugin auto-creates its folders on install and detects renames automatically.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log trades and track performance, and other trading journal plugins reportedly require overhauling the whole vault workflow.
summary: Trading journal plugin that adds a sidebar panel with a trades table, inline editing, a PnL dashboard, and configurable checklists.
